title: Emissions disclosure
description: Disclosure that the seller will report greenhouse-gas emissions for fulfilling this order under a named accounting methodology. The methodology is FREE-FORM — any standard, existing or future (e.g. "GHG Protocol Corporate Standard", "ISO 14064", "PAS 2050", "EN 16258", or a custom methodology). The protocol takes no closed list of standards. The clause stores no scope classification: scope 1/2/3 is relative to a reporting entity's boundary, and a reader derives it from its own position in the process topology. The measured emissions value is filed as a runtime attestation at stage 1; a correction is simply a later attestation at the same stage, weighed by readers. Offset procurement (retirement via a carbon router) is out of protocol scope — it composes as a separate on-network contract when one exists.
